verdict.rationale: Riveter documents a `dry_run: true` flag that validates a request and returns a credit estimate without creating or charging anything. That is a dry-run, not a sandbox: it executes nothing, so you cannot test real behavior against isolated data. The `max_credits` cap is likewise only a spending guard. No sandbox environment, test mode, or test API keys separated from production data are documented, so this is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: dry_run: true — validate the request and return a credit estimate without creating or charging anything.
